flags.why: This is a formal, respectful word for supporting one's elders, as recorded in [VDict](https://vdict.com/ph%E1%BB%A5ng%20d%C6%B0%E1%BB%A1ng%2C3%2C0%2C0.html?lang=vi).
This word is mainly Southern usage and is listed in the [Dictionary of Southern Vietnamese](https://dokumen.pub/tu-dien-tu-ngu-nam-bo.html).

The word remains current in everyday educational vocabulary, including [Macmillan's learner word list](https://cdn.macmillanyounglearners.com/englishworld/public/hsc_wl2_vi.pdf), so dated misleadingly suggests it is obsolete.
